name: How long does it take to remove a threshold and complete a curbless shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove a threshold and complete a curbless shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for removing a bathroom threshold and converting to a curbless shower typically ranges from one to two weeks, depending on the project's scope. This duration includes demolition, any necessary subfloor adjustments, plumbing modifications, extensive waterproofing, tile installation, and curing times for various materials. Unforeseen issues like structural surprises or specialized material availability can sometimes extend the timeline. We provide a projected schedule during the planning phase for each project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A curbless shower conversion typically takes one to two weeks, accounting for demolition, subfloor work, waterproofing, tiling, and curing times.
